ms.report:

Milestone Report:

Complete documentation of all deliverables including:
- 9 resolved backlog issues from lucid-evolution (with code evidence, file paths, and test commands)
- Architectural restructuring from monolithic to modular design for the core, provider, and wallet packages
- Effect v3.x migration and TypeScript strict mode compliance
- A mapping of every resolved issue to the merged pull requests where the fix landed
- Step-by-step verification instructions, pinned to the exact repository commit the report describes

Mapping to the acceptance criteria:
- Compliance with the new code style guideline: covered in the report's restructuring and strict mode sections
- Documented module structure with comments and examples: covered in the module structure section of the report
- Backlog items resolved and categorized with verifiable evidence: each of the 9 issues is listed with GitHub issue links and pull request references
- Updated module structure documented and verified through PRs: see the Issue to Pull Request Mapping table in the report

See report for full details on issue resolutions, code locations, testing, and verification steps.

Complete documentation of all deliverables including:
- 12 resolved backlog items across the three package areas (plutus, utils, core-types), each with GitHub issue links, resolving files, test evidence, and pull request references
- Architectural restructuring of the legacy lucid-evolution/plutus, lucid-evolution/utils, and lucid-evolution/core-types packages into the standardized module structure, with a package mapping table
- A module-to-pull-request attribution table for the structural changes
- Verbatim code excerpts and step-by-step verification instructions, pinned to the exact repository commit the report describes
